title: 'std_collection'
description: 'Standardize Herbarium Acronyms in Collection Records'
toc: true

---


```{r}
#| eval: false
barRoso::std_collection()
```

### Description

Cleans and standardizes herbarium acronyms in biodiversity datasets by harmonizing
values from the `collectionCode` and `institutionCode` fields. The function
corrects common issues in GBIF and other aggregated records, replacing ambiguous
or placeholder codes with the herbarium acronyms of
[Index Herbariorum](https://sweetgum.nybg.org/science/ih/).

### Details

This function is part of the `barRoso` package. Instead of a dictionary of
every code, it uses regular expressions that generalize across datasets, in
the following order:

- Aggregated collections like `"Tropicos"` or `"MO-Duplicates"` are replaced with the herbarium of the specimen given in `institutionCode` (e.g. `"NY"`), or with `"MO"` when it is missing.
- Generic words like `"Botany"`, `"Herbarium"`, `"Vascular Plants"` or `"PNGplants"` are replaced with the acronym in `institutionCode` or, when missing, with the acronym at the beginning of `catalogNumber` (e.g. `"U.1317533"` into `"U"`) or in `occurrenceID` (e.g. `"urn:catalog:INB:..."`).
- Names of collections, like `"F-Seedplants"`, `"BHCB-Fanerogamas"`, `"INPA-Carpoteca"`, `"R-Tipos"`, `"UIS-H"` or `"BSMvplantscoll"`, are reduced to the herbarium acronym. Codes of wood collections, like `"INPAw"`, are kept, as they are Index Herbariorum codes.
- Names of herbaria and institutions, like `"Herbario INPA"`, `"Herbario Nacional de Costa Rica (CR)"` or `"Instituto de Botanica de Sao Paulo"`, are replaced with the acronym given in the name or with the known acronym.
- Codes that are not acronyms, like observation projects (`"Observations"`, `"Dados de Pesquisa SISBio"`), companies (`"Ecopetrol S.A"`) or numbers, are replaced with the acronym in `institutionCode` or `catalogNumber`, or with `NA`.

The columns `catalogNumber` and `occurrenceID` are used when present.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| df | A data frame with biodiversity specimen records. |
| colname_collectionCode | Name of the column containing collection codes (default: `"collectionCode"`). |
| colname_institutionCode | Name of the column containing institution codes (default: `"institutionCode"`). |
| rm_original_column | Logical; if `TRUE`, original columns are removed after cleaning (default: `TRUE`). |

### Value

A data frame with standardized collection codes in the `collectionCode` column.
If `rm_original_column = FALSE`, the original values are saved with a *Original suffix.

### Examples

```r
df <- data.frame(collectionCode = c("Tropicos", "Botany", "F-Seedplants",
                                    "Herbario INPA", "Observations"),
                 institutionCode = c("NY", NA, "F", "INPA", "iNaturalist"),
                 catalogNumber = c("100595392", "U.1317533", "V0059731F",
                                   "123", "340214363"))
std_collection(df)$collectionCode
```
